name: AI sales team · Research, outreach and replies

parameters.content:
## AI sales team · Research, outreach and replies
Seven agents run outbound end to end: research each new lead, score it, write and review every email, read the replies, propose meeting times and answer objections from the case studies. A person is asked whenever an agent is unsure.

**Platforms:** Typeform, Clearbit, SerpAPI, Claude, OpenAI, HubSpot, Supabase, Mailchimp, Pinecone, SendGrid, Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack
**Source and tests:** github.com/kimjoshuadr/n8n-workflows · `systems/ai-sales-team`

nodes.name: Section: A new lead: research, score, start

parameters.content:
## 1. A new lead: research, score, start
Typeform in. Clearbit and SerpAPI gather facts, two agents read them, and code applies the rules a model may not overrule.

## 2. Outreach: write, review, send
Hourly. One agent writes, a second one reviews, code checks both. A rejected email gets one rewrite, then a person.

## 3. Replies: read, decide, act
Gmail in. A classifier reads the reply, then a booking agent or an objection agent answers, or a person is asked.

## 4. Weekly report
The funnel is counted in code. An agent writes three sentences about it.

options.systemMessage: You are the Research agent on a sales team. From the dossier, write what a salesperson needs before a first email: a two-sentence summary of the company, the likely pains this person has in their role, and one or two specific hooks taken from the news or from what they wrote. Use only what is in the dossier. If the dossier is thin, say so in the summary and return fewer hooks. Never invent a fact, a number or a news item.

parameters.description: Turns an employee count into a size band. Pass the number of employees.
parameters.jsCode: const n = Number(query); if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 'unknown'; return n < 11 ? 'micro (1-10)' : n < 51 ? 'small (11-50)' : n < 251 ? 'mid (51-250)' : 'large (250+)';

options.systemMessage: You are the Scoring agent. Score how well this lead fits a services business that sells website and automation projects to companies with a team and a budget. Reply with a score from 0 to 100, whether it is a fit, and one sentence of reasoning that quotes the evidence. Judge only what is in front of you.

parameters.jsCode:
const l = $("Which path?").first().json;
return [{ json: { channel: "#sales", level: "info", text: "New qualified lead: " + l.name + (l.dossier.company ? " (" + l.dossier.company + ")" : "") + ", score " + l.score + ". " + l.reason + " A sequence has started." } }];

const l = $("Which path?").first().json;
return [{ json: { source: "ai-sales-team", reason: "HubSpot contact could not be created", payload: { email: l.email, name: l.name, score: l.score } } }];

const l = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { channel: "#sales", level: "warn", text: "A new lead needs a person (" + l.email + "): " + l.reason } }];

// Twenty an hour: enough to be useful, slow enough that a mistake is caught before it is sent to everyone.
return $input.all().map((i) => i.json).filter((s) => s.email).slice(0, 20).map((json) => ({ json }));

options.systemMessage: You are the Writer agent. Write one short outreach email for the brief you are given: under 120 words, plain text, one idea, one question or next step, signed 'Kim'. Use the research for something specific to this person. You may search the case studies for one relevant proof point, and you may only cite a result that the search returned. No hype, no 'I hope this finds you well', no invented numbers. Do not repeat an earlier subject line.

parameters.toolDescription: Search the company's case studies for a relevant proof point. Pass a short description of the lead's industry or problem.

options.systemMessage: You are the Reviewer agent. You did not write this email and you are not trying to be kind about it. Approve it only if it is specific to this person, makes no claim the brief does not support, has one clear ask, and sounds like a person wrote it. List every problem you find.

metadata.subject: ={{ 'Outreach email ' + (Number($('One lead at a time').first().json.step ?? 0) + 1) + ' sent by the sales agents.' }}
metadata.body: ={{ 'Outreach email ' + (Number($('One lead at a time').first().json.step ?? 0) + 1) + ' sent by the sales agents.' }}

options.systemMessage: You are the Reviser agent. Rewrite the email so that every listed issue is fixed, and change nothing else about what it says. Same rules as before: under 120 words, plain text, one ask, nothing the brief does not support.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { channel: "#sales", level: "warn", text: "An outreach email to " + d.email + " was held back: " + d.issues.join("; ") + ". The sequence is paused until someone looks." } }];

options.systemMessage: You are the Reply classifier. Read a reply to a sales email and say what the person wants: 'interested' (wants to talk or asks for times), 'objection' (a concern or a question about the offer), 'not_now' (maybe later), 'unsubscribe' (stop writing), or 'out_of_office' (an automatic reply). Give your confidence from 0 to 1. If it could be two of these, pick the more cautious one and lower your confidence.

You are the Booking agent. The person is interested. Look up free time in the calendar for the next five working days and reply offering exactly three slots of 30 minutes, in their words' tone, in under 80 words, signed 'Kim'. Offer only times the calendar returned as free.

parameters.toolDescription: Checks whether the calendar is free between two times. Call it once per candidate slot.

parameters.jsCode:
const s = $("Find the sequence").first().json;
return [{ json: { channel: "#sales", level: "info", text: s.name + " replied and is interested. Three times were offered and a deal is open in HubSpot." } }];

options.systemMessage: You are the Objection agent. Answer the person's concern or question honestly, using only what the product and case study search returns. If the search does not cover it, say you will find out and set your confidence low. Under 100 words, signed 'Kim'. Never argue, never discount, never promise a result.

parameters.toolDescription: Search the product documentation and case studies to answer a prospect's question or concern.

parameters.jsCode:
const s = $("Read the intent").first().json;
return [{ json: { channel: "#sales", level: "warn", text: s.name + " (" + s.email + ") replied and an agent was not sure how to answer: \"" + s.reply.text.slice(0, 240) + "\". The sequence is paused." } }];

options.systemMessage: You are the Analyst agent. Write three sentences for a sales lead about last week's outbound numbers: what moved, what needs attention, and one thing to try. Use only the numbers given. Do not invent a cause.

'The written summary is unavailable this week.') + '\nSent ' + $('Count the funnel').first().json.sent + ' · replies ' + $('Count the funnel').first().json.replied + ' (' + $('Count the funnel').first().json.reply_rate + '%) · meetings proposed ' + $('Count the funnel').first().json.meetings + ' · waiting on a person ' + $('Count the funnel').first().json.needs_review }}
